svg.text: Both 6-second window histograms — value of results vs. quantity of that value (log, each to its own scale)
blue = case 1 (007 A, solo record) · orange = case 2 (066 A, buried entrance) · capped at 145% — values cannot exceed √2 ≈ 141%
the color GRADIENT on the same axis: pure green <70% · green→yellow 70–100% · yellow→red 100–125% · pure red ≥125%
amber/yellow readings can be a correct seat in a busy mix — believe the confidence number there
